def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_row=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    L=line_row[0]; lc=g[L][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=lc and not (len(set(g[r]))==1)]
    rows=sorted({r for r,c in cells})
    sr0,sr1=rows[0],rows[-1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
    if sr1<L:
        d=(L-1)-sr1
        newtop=sr0+d
        out[newtop-1]=[8]*w
    else:
        d=(L+1)-sr0
        newbot=sr1+d
        out[newbot+1]=[8]*w
    for r,c in cells: out[r+d][c]=g[r][c]
    return out
